messages:
lila: FYI — alerting on audit-ingest: prod customer topic spiked ~30k events/s over last 10m, consumer lag rising, end-to-end latency ~2s, seeing 429s from kms-encryptor. suspect RBAC change earlier today increased read-audit volume. :warning:

nate: saw the dashboard. kafka partitions show partition-12 hot, ISR ok. KMS account-level throttle hitting ~1200 req/s, kills our per-event encrypt path.

maya: if RBAC churn causes more fine-grained events per request we need tighter schema + dedupe or we'll keep amplifying noise. can we add event priority or sampling flag?

zoe: quick mitigations we can roll in the next hour: 1) enable batch+gzip at ingress (batch size 20 default), 2) temporary drop telemetry_debug / low_priority events at ingress, 3) fallback to local ephemeral signing when KMS returns 429s (write to audit with kms-marked=true).

samir: local signing is workable but we must log any ephemeral key usage to KMS (meta-record) so forensics still possible. plus rotate ephemeral keys frequently.

nate: proposed circuit-breaker config (proto):
```
circuit_breaker:
  max_inflight: 50000
  per_tenant_qps: 2000
  kms_retry: 3
  kms_backoff_ms: 200
  drop_policy: "defer_low"
```

maya: adding schema change: new required fields: tenant_id, trace_id; optional: event_priority (HIGH|MED|LOW). ingress validator should reject events missing tenant_id/trace_id to avoid blind storage costs. For migration, default event_priority=MED if absent. Also add dedupe_key optional.

zoe: indexing/cost note: full-text index of raw audit payloads for all tenants increases ES storage & IOPS ~3x. recommendation: hot index (7d full) + cold index (90d metadata only) + archival to S3 for >90d. customers wanting full retention can opt-in (billing impact).

lila: customer-facing policy: publish that low_priority events may be sampled/dropped under sustained backpressure and provide guidance to set event_priority for guaranteed delivery. update SLA doc. @support please flag customers who will be impacted.

billing-bot: projected delta if we keep 90d full-text hot for top10 tenants: +$12,400/mo storage + $4,800/mo ops. (rough estimate)

maya: concrete action items: (1) deploy ingress batching + gzip (feature flag), (2) add event_priority to audit schema + ingress validation, (3) apply kms circuit-breaker with local-ephemeral fallback, (4) run canary at 5% tenants + monitor per-tenant qps, (5) update customer docs + runbook.

zoe: I'll open PR for batching + feature flag. ETA ~4h. includes metrics: batched_events/sec, avg_batch_size, batch_latency_ms.

nate: I'll add dynamic partitioner for kafka and a rebalancer throttle. will also wire a per-partition hotness metric so we can autosplit. rebalancing note: expect transient consumer lag.

lila: runbook updates: when audit-ingest throttles -> 1) flip batching ff on, 2) enable drop-low-priority, 3) notify customers, 4) escalate to eng-sre + security if KMS errors persist >5m. add playbook entry.

ops-bot: incident created: #inc-214 audit-ingest-spike. responders: eng-sre, eng-security.

maya: last check: we'll also add a validation error signal to the API surface so customers get 4xx when they submit malformed/missing fields instead of us silently accepting junk that bloats cost. please include example snippets in the docs.

lila: agreed. thanks all — let's keep this thread for deployment updates and paste deploy links here. :thumbsup:
